A '''magnetic tape''' was a form of data storage. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] kept several ancient magnetic tapes bearing plans for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction in a case beneath his [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|dwelling]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="JH" />
